headline: Stealth's space-bunny-alpha hits 14.7%, day 2 at the top
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha just claimed the #1 spot yesterday and is holding it with 14.7% token share—an all-time high and its second consecutive day leading the pack. Meanwhile, Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash keeps climbing (day 3 of record highs at 5.8%), and OpenAI's gpt-6-luna is on its own streak at 2.8%. Tencent took a hard tumble, shedding 3.4 percentage points in a single day.
highlights: xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash-20260921: 5.8% share, rank #5 (day 3 of all-time highs)
openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922: 2.8% share, rank #10 (day 3 of record highs)
tencent/hy4-preview plummeted from rank #5 to #9, losing 2.5 percentage points in 24 hours
DeepSeek and stealth combined hold 36.1% of all tokens; top 3 providers control 48.5%
xAI's grok-4.7 enters at rank #33 with 0.5% share
